P8 integration notes (draft for docs/ARCHITECTURE.md and docs/BALANCE.md; P10 folds them in)
==========================================================================================

Endless (A16, D22)
- levelgen.generateChunk runs with the module flag endlessGen set (try/finally around chunkEvents). While set, applyGap is a no-op, which also covers gainOf (it materialises gates through
  the same path), and the layout weights come from LEVELS.endless.layoutWeights, the 1.3.0 values. Endless gates are back to 1.3.0; only the accepted D11-19 wave splits (F12's WAVE_WEIGHTS L30 row) remain.

Readiness
- level._runRequest re-checks _partsReady after its parts resolve, up to REQ_PREP_TRIES rounds. A prepare can resolve with programs missing (context loss, tier commit, dead run). After the
  last round start() plays on with its 'level.unprepared' warning, so a spinner never hangs.
- An abandoned Horde tile: crowd.prepare and hold.prepare carry a { dead } run through render.addWarmable(obj, run); level._beginRun calls cancelPrepare() on both when the run's base has no
  crowd (endless too). The prepare stops between chunks, stays unready, and the next prepare() finishes it from the program cache. The night equivalent is render.setNight killing its run.

Stage flags
- LEVEL_TYPES.horde.enabled and .night.enabled are true. chase, escort and the combos stay off for 1.5.0.
- ui.js isBlackout reads NIGHT.blackout.districts, the same data render.setNight uses, so the badge and the lamps cannot drift apart.

Tools
- smoke --matrix [filter]: 3 types x High / Medium / Low / software x phone / landscape, one Chrome per cell, lock free between cells. Writes matrix.json. See the header of tools/smoke.js.
- harness/p8: real.mjs (a plain URL, real taps, event log, bots), seq.mjs (scenes fresh, owner, ownerprev, retype, idle, assist, sweep), dbgcopy.mjs, boottime.mjs (D46 row), reqcheck.mjs, gates.sh, mkpreview.sh, seedpage.mjs.

Lessons and the pause card (fix round 1)
- hold.sweep is marked by the drag itself: hold._sampleLane calls hold._done('hold.sweep') when _sweepM reaches HORDE lessons.sweepM, next to _release. hint:release alone leaves a pill under HINT_MARK_S unmarked (level.js relies on that for subjects that merely passed), so a player who obeyed within 1.5 s met it again on every Horde.
- STRINGS.pause.controlsKeysHold / controlsTouchHold: ui._fillPauseControls picks them while hold.active, so the card names sweep and REPAIR in a hold and steer in the run part of the same level.

Preview (harness/p8/mkpreview.sh)
- Three trees under E:/Temp/claude/r8build: preview (plain, starts at L1), preview-owner (first-run owner-like save), preview-debug (preview-owner with &debug=1 appended in js/main.js, for a host that never passes a query string). The title is rewritten in the copies only; the repo's artifact.html stays Gate Rush.

Test-tool notes
- p6/holdrace.mjs does not race anything: under ?type=horde the override applies to every level, L1 included, so its second tap waits for the same prepare. p8/race.mjs is the same tool without ?type (a real Horde tile, a real day tile).
- A lesson read by nobody is shown again (ui._attended, r7): a bot that acts only through the input fields is not attending. seq.mjs sends a real touch every 3 s, except in the idle scene.
- A ?debug=1 run never shows the briefing unless ?typesPreview=1 is set too (P7), so the smoke matrix plays straight through; the briefing rows are in seq.mjs on a plain URL.

Row 31, economy (fix round 2; a FAILED reading, handed to P9)
- The first report's "+7 %" on L43 was a tool error: coins.mjs took the premium off the whole payout. The premium is on the level bonus only (level.js starRaw). coins.mjs now takes it off bonusStars, adds a 3-star figure, the +-20 % verdict against the RUN neighbours and the crowd's share, and exits 1 on a miss.
- The share is the crowd's coins AS CREDITED (real.mjs wraps level._onCrowdKills and reads breakdown.kills across it, so coinMult is in). All of it lands in phase 'hold', so ECONOMY.bossFightKillMult never touches it.
- Readings: P8/r2/coins.txt, head ab62b1e, one bot run per level, so a reading and not a rate. fresh raises ranks between levels (coinMult 1.4 on L3, 1.5 on L4). A 'before' figure is the income without the premium; 'at 3 stars' rebuilds the star line.
    L4  horde 3 stars  680 against L3 360 +89 %; L5 190 +258 % (a 1-star bot run; at 3 stars 295, +131 %)
    L9  horde 3 stars  1,263 against L8 1,026 +23 %; L10 1,030 +23 % (at 3 stars 1,150, +10 %)
    L43 horde 2 stars  5,589 against L44 4,259 +31 %; at 3 stars 6,039, +42 %
    L7  night 2 stars  521 against L6 442 +18 %; L8 1,026 -49 % (at 3 stars -40 %). RUN itself steps from 442 to 1,026 across L6-L8, so this is mostly that step.
    L45 night 2 stars  3,839 against L44 4,259 -10 %; at 3 stars 4,309, +1 %. Inside the band.
    Crowd share (band 25-35 %): L4 37.2 %, L9 41.3 %, L39 55.8 and 56.2 %, L43 53.0 %. All kill coins, the RUN part included: L4 39.4 %, L9 52.4 %, L39 70 %, L43 71.3 %.
- The knob is HORDE_GEN.coins.scale, now [[4, 0.15], [30, 0.5]]. Total raw crowd coin = scale x n1(L); past L30 it is pinned to 0.5 x n1(34) = 1,500 raw, so it stops growing and rank 10 pays x2.
- Estimates only, nothing below was run: holding every other bucket, a 30 % share needs the crowd coin at about x0.72 on L4, x0.61 on L9, x0.38 on L43 and x0.34 on L39 (x0.26 to x0.48 across the 25-35 % band at L39-43). That is roughly scale [[4, 0.11], [30, 0.19]]. L43 would then pay about 3,830, about 3,720 before premium: -13 % against L44 as played and about -2 % at 3 stars. L9 about 1,050, about +2 %. L4 stays high at about +69 % against L3, because its non-crowd income (446) already beats L3's 360, so L4 needs its own look (piles 88, level bonus, LINE HELD 40).
- Share depends on rank: coinMult scales kills and boss only, so a low-rank player's share is lower than these. Fix which shop the row is read at before fitting. Verifier r2 estimated about 41 % at L43 with coinMult 1; not measured here.
- The same pass owns idle coins on RETRY (A22): the four idle L43 attempts kept 1,482, 1,089, 1,836 and 1,865 coins.

For P9's checks
- validate-levels --from 121 --to 300 is not in any chain after P8 and fails today: 4 errors (L187, L207, L232, L277, passive clears at 0.70-0.83 E_hold). Row 2 fails past L120. P9 must add this range to its run.

For the main session (publish)
- The trees come from r8/P8 at ab62b1e and the plan says export r8-140. After the squash merge: bash harness/p8/mkpreview.sh r8-140, then node harness/p8/mkfilelist.mjs <out.json>. git archive reads the ref from the P8 worktree, so nothing there needs to move.
- The page plus the 27 files in the manifest (26 js, css/game.css) are enough: verifier r2 smoked exactly that tree, clean, 0 failed requests.
- Steer the owner to preview-owner for play. preview-debug is for the overlay only: a debug run skips the briefing unless ?typesPreview=1 is set, so that copy never shows the first-meeting flow.

For owner checkpoint 2 (from the existing D18 / B1 rule, not new in P8)
- At rank 10 on L7, seed 1007, 215 soldiers met a 53,200 HP Hulk and 52 soldiers met 564,350 HP (level.js _bossUnderFloor, (E/C)^2, minRatio 0.3), so one bad last gate makes that boss unwinnable. Worth one line to the owner.

Test-tool notes (fix round 2)
- seq retype RETRIES until the clear on both the first run and the replay (up to 8): the bot's L7 outcome on seed 1007 turns on its last gates, so one loss proved nothing. A lost attempt is now a row (record untouched), and x0.6 is read exactly from bonusStars on a clear.
- dbgcopy loads artifact.html, where the seed lives, so it can read hl 43. Only the local server's /favicon.ico 404 is forgiven.
- The level:complete payload's score can be fractional (37076.6); the screen and rec.bestScore are integers in the runs read. Harmless, left alone.
